subject.title: fix(memory-core): honor private-network settings for OpenAI-compatible embeddings

question: Should configured memory embedding providers use omitted policy as exact-hostname trust, explicit `false` as full private-network denial, and explicit `true` as broad private-network opt-in?
rationale: The patch consistently follows the shared provider transport policy, but selecting these SSRF and upgrade semantics requires maintainer intent rather than code-level inference.

options.title: Approve three-state contract
options.body: Land the documented and proven omitted exact-hostname trust, explicit denial, and explicit broad opt-in behavior.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Make omitted policy block private endpoints and require `true`, accepting a larger compatibility break.

options.title: Preserve prior exact-host trust
options.body: Do not let explicit `false` disable configured-host trust for embeddings, weakening the meaning of the existing denial setting.

recommendation.title: Approve three-state contract
recommendation.body: Land the documented and proven omitted exact-hostname trust, explicit denial, and explicit broad opt-in behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the canonical provider request resolver and current private-network policy fields used by this PR.
